title: Valentine’s Banquet
description: A church hall dressed for Valentine’s. Chair backs are tied off in red satin down every row, and the serving table carries a heart-print runner, a bud vase with a single rose, and red favours boxed under a printed banner.

alt.valentines-sweetheart-table.jpg: A Valentine's Day banner above a serving table with a heart-print runner, a single rose in a bottle, and red favours
alt.chairs-tied-with-red-bows.jpg: Rows of hall chairs with red satin bows tied to the backs and single roses tucked into the ribbon
